import sys

def read_input():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    f = list(map(int, data[1:]))
    return n, f

def apply_function(f, x):
    return f[x - 1]

def is_idempotent(f, n):
    for x in range(1, n + 1):
        if apply_function(f, apply_function(f, x)) != apply_function(f, x):
            return False
    return True

def find_minimum_k(n, f):
    k = 1
    current_f = f[:]
    while not is_idempotent(current_f, n):
        k += 1
        next_f = [apply_function(current_f, x) for x in range(1, n + 1)]
        current_f = next_f
    return k

def main():
    n, f = read_input()
    k = find_minimum_k(n, f)
    print(k)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
